decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9187. Series context: trend strength 0.3908 and seasonal strength 0.2969; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.088); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.369.
